purpose: Teach: 魔王/アーケード/パイプライン/抗体/動植物/音階/鷲/製鉄

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、絵本の魔王のキャラに夢中ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that child is completely captivated by the dark lord character from the picture book, isn't she?
lines.style: Warm observation, slight smile in the voice. Gentle, noticing tone. Soft pace. A tender comment shared between friends who notice small things.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、商店街のアーケードでお茶を頂きたいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, I've been wanting to sit down and have tea with you at the shopping arcade.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful opening. Slower pace. Weighing the words as she speaks them. A gentle vulnerability underneath — she's bringing something she's been thinking about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、海底パイプラインの研究のお仕事だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer you mentioned — the one researching deep-sea pipelines for work — he seems so dedicated.
lines.style: Reflective, observant tone. Moderate pace. Noticing the detail, turning it over gently. Not judgmental, just... seeing what's in front of her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、抗体検査の結果を待ってらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And that other regular, he's been waiting on antibody test results, hasn't he? You could see it on him.
lines.style: Softer, more measured. A little concern woven in. Pace slows slightly. The recognition of someone carrying something unseen.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、動植物の図鑑が好きみたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The child loves those animal and plant encyclopedias. It's sweet to watch her get lost in them.
lines.style: Tender, genuine warmth. Unhurried pace. A small, knowing smile in the delivery. She's watching someone she cares about noticing the small joys.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ピアノの音階の練習をされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer has been practicing his piano scales. I heard you mention it the other day.
lines.style: Reflective, remembering. Calm, even pace. Demonstrating she listens to what Aoi shares. A quiet presence, not pushing, just... there.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お土産に鷲の置物を持ってこられたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And he brought you an eagle figurine as a gift from his travels. That was thoughtful of him.
lines.style: Warm observation with a touch of curiosity. Moderate, steady pace. Slight lilt at the end — she's noticing Aoi noticing people's kindnesses.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、製鉄所のお仕事のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He was telling you about his work at the steel mill, wasn't he? Those stories matter to him.
lines.style: Gentle, understanding close. Quiet, reflective pace. Trailing slightly. The recognition that these small moments—listening to someone's day—are what really connect us.
